ns2:section.sectionText: Students will utilize a combination of LON-CAPA lessons, Blackboard Collaborate-based discussion sections and office hours, and required e-book access. Students are required to attend one of the two Blackboard Collaborate sessions, either from 1:00-3:00 pm or from 4:00 -6:00 pm, on Fridays. Two proctored hourly exams and a proctored final exam will be given either on campus or via ProctorU.
